_about: The one statement of the Writing request minimum that both sides are held to. writing_coach/writing_limits.py (the server) and static/orena/capabilities/writing-limits.js (the browser) each carry their own implementation; tests/test_writing_minimum.py and scripts/test_orena_writing_workspace.mjs both read THIS file and fail when either side stops producing exactly these tables and these counts. Change a number or a case here and both gates say so.
